builder_interpretations.text: Connector body footprints are the pinned G2 option window rectangles (J1501 8.3 x 4.6, J201 3.4 x 2.9, J202 3.5 x 3.0 mm), oriented with the long side tangential or radial; no body drawing exists. SR-FPC-MECH / SR-BATT-PCM / SR-CHG-MECH decide.

The G4 case-side support (BATTERY + REAR levels) is carried at BATTERY level only: a continuous raised cup wall occupies the REAR-level periphery and a post there would interrupt it (ring continuity, seal). The G4 plan layout is unchanged; the Z extent is the pinned BATTERY level.

K_t 2.0 is applied at the pod-frame (inner) junction, at the ring-plate junction, at the charger feedthrough hole radii and at the ring; the stress without the inner-junction K_t is reported beside sigma_allow_req.

The PCM lobe envelope is authored (radial protrusion 1.5 / 2.5 / 3.0 mm, tangential width 5.0 / 6.5 / 8.0 mm, Z = pack Z); the design azimuth is 230 deg and the carrier / lobe conflicts are evaluated at 220, 230 and 240 deg.

Ring section = wall radial width x [plate bottom, wall top] minus the gland groove; the plate outer edge is the ring centroid radius (conservative span); the plate in-plane response uses the Lame solution of the outer-region thickness; the radial hoop pressure on the exposed wall is added in magnitude; the ring is continuous over 360 deg (the charger land and the lug-root screws lie outside the wall radius).

Z gaps use the nominal layer boundaries, each solid's own adverse growth, and the dimension-chain tolerance of the layers fully between the two references; the pack top is the battery-zone top minus c_axial; B.Cu items hang from the B.Cu plane at their linear-worst height.

The MAIN-outline column is the Ø46 development disk plus growth arcs up to the G4 maximum outline; growth arcs exclude the closed reserved intervals and the frozen switch windows, shrunk by the PCB outline positional tolerance angle.

Reserved solid = clock interval over the radiator radial span union the radiator volume, at the volume's pinned Z levels (FRONT = front gap + display + cover). The pack and the PCM lobe are new conductive components; carrier, cup, O-ring, SW1 / SW5 pushers / boots / dielectric boss growth are allowed non-conductive items with G5 records; volumes are cell-sampled (0.2 mm).

No offset satisfies every constraint; the joint offset is the one with the fewest total violations (reserved-region hits + carrier conflicts), then the supports, then the radial room; exact connector placement is run for the five best-ranked offsets.

A lane is "failed" when its predicate is false at every grid point with D <= 50.9 mm (the largest grid D whose OD margin 51.00 - (D + 2 tol) is >= 0); the joint D is the smallest D at which every other lane passes; tw is the thinnest passing wall.

The design cup is the configuration that passes the hard deflection check with the least intrusion (ring widening 0, then the lowest wall top, then the lowest stress); the smallest gland-feasible cross-section is the design row; other rows are reported as alternatives.

FPC / tail / drop paths are polylines (tail exit -> lower-web groove -> foot bend at the adverse bend radius -> vertical riser; tail: PCM exit at pack mid-thickness -> riser; drop: FT-C inner face -> riser); the service slack (adverse 30 mm) is a planar U-loop pocket in the REAR-periphery band.

Q-R2-SUPPORT-RING (conditional, tool-raised): the over-allocation between the BATTERY-level case supports and the raised cup wall is quantified by a second ledger in which the supports start above the cup wall top; this is a quantification, not a decision.
Disks and sectors are exact (analytic) in the clearance kernel; polygon supersets (circumscribed) are used elsewhere with a documented 0.01 mm allowance (POLY_SLACK_MM) that is never a credit.

The F.Cu fallback exclusions are the pinned F.Cu courtyards, the U101 shield polygon, DISP_FPC, ALS, SWD, DISP_LAND, the MAIN-level radiator / reserved regions and MAG_CLEAR; the body must lie under the display (r <= R_display) with c_lra_plan.
The charger block height allocation maximum is the lower-web underside (adverse) minus c_insert; it is an SR-CHG-MECH allocation threshold, not a credit.
The occupancy ledger is cell-sampled (0.5 mm); the exact pair table decides clearance; the double-occupied cell count is reported per band.

For each switch / topology / pusher class the smallest closing boss is found by an exact reduction verified with the production predicates (bore margin rises 1:1 with the boss, protrusion falls with it); the occupant footprint of a switch is the union over its closing options.

A1-A11 keep identities, order, parts, directions and battery states; only the operation text of A1, A4, A5, A6, A9, A10, A11 changes and each change cites its decision id; A5 stays after A4 (the LRA is bonded on the MAIN sub-assembly before the stack closes, inside A4/A5 content).

Runtimes are printed by check / selftest and recorded in the run report only (a timestamp or runtime inside a byte-compared file would break determinism); the JSON carries evaluation counts and the budgets.

The pose search stops evaluating a candidate pose at its first violated clearance pair (the pass / fail answer is identical to the exhaustive evaluation; verified against the exhaustive evaluation on a pose sample in the self-test, pa_early_exit_equals_exhaustive); the evaluation counter counts the pair predicates actually evaluated.
The launch spec left the expected HEAD placeholder unfilled; the tool pins and verifies the R2 contract commit 8f89904 recorded in inputs.r2_contract_commit (the parent is the R1 record 27f7a3a).

  through the case (stem O-ring or elastomer boot/seal, whichever
  closes), pressing a right-angle side-actuated tactile switch at the
  MAIN board edge; local case bosses <= +3.0 mm (incl. seal and
  tolerance) at the five existing button windows only (10, 9, 8, 2,
  4 o'clock). C-R1-03 ruling not needed. Inductive/force buttons
  deferred to Rev-B. SG: SR-BUTTONS.
- OD-CONN-SIDE: J1501, J201, J202 on MAIN B.Cu; U7 (DRV2625) to B.Cu.

- OD-J202 / Q-R1-CHARGER: J202 on B.Cu toward east; charger contacts on

  except the local charger drop. C-R1-01 2(v) AMENDED to: clear in 3-D,

- OD-G4-LRA-ARCH: LRA on MAIN B.Cu in the battery annulus (battery

- Q-R1-MAIN-SEAL: raised, serviceable radial O-ring on a caseback cup.

owner_questions.text: The four BATTERY-level case-side supports (G4 layout, SUP_SW / SUP_SE / SUP_NE / SUP_WNW) occupy the outer annulus the raised cup wall must rise into.
